day0_welcome.title: Welcome to HoakHaven
day0_welcome.step0_dialogue: Welcome to HoakHaven! It's a peaceful little village where we farm, mine, and play games. Let's start your new life here and have some fun.

day1_strata.title: Day 1: Getting Your Hands Dirty
day1_strata.step0_dialogue: Hey there! I'm Thorek. If you want to survive here, you need to work. Grab a pickaxe and let's see what you can find in the mines.
day1_strata.step1_activity: Goal: Use `!mine` 10 times to gather some resources.
day1_strata.step2_dialogue: Not bad! You're a natural. Go see Elara now, she knows what to do with dirt.

day2_alchemy.title: Day 2: Planting the Seeds
day2_alchemy.step0_dialogue: Hi, I'm Elara! Mining is great, but farming is where the real money is. Let's plant some seeds and watch them grow!
day2_alchemy.step2_choice: Are you ready to be a great farmer?

day3_base.title: Day 3: Settling Down
day3_base.step0_req: Goal: Accumulate 500 Money and 2 Iron Ore to prove your commitment.
day3_base.step1_activity: Goal: Buy your first House (The Starter Shack) using `!house shop`.
day3_base.step2_dialogue: You're doing great! It's time to settle down properly. Go ahead and buy yourself a little shack.

day4_will.title: Day 4: Exploring the Wilds
day4_will.step0_dialogue: Hey, I'm Irian. The woods can be dangerous, but if you're lucky, you might find a cute pet out there. Let's go hunting!
day4_will.step2_dialogue: You found one! A Mystery Egg. Let's take good care of it.

day5_odds.title: Day 5: Testing Your Luck
day5_odds.description: Introduction to GambleBot and the Casino.
day5_odds.step0_dialogue: Beep boop! I'm GambleBot. Working hard is cool, but winning big is cooler. Come try your luck at the Casino!
day5_odds.step2_dialogue: Win or lose, it's all about having fun! Keep rolling those dice.

day6_contribution.title: Day 6: Pitching In
day6_contribution.step0_dialogue: The village needs your help! The central generator is running out of juice. Let's all chip in to keep the lights on.
day6_contribution.step1_req: Goal: Donate 5 Iron Ore and 5 Wheat to the Village Power Grid.

day7_sprout.title: Day 7: Defending the Village
day7_sprout.step0_event: Uh oh! The generator powered up, but it woke up a grumpy old robot! Get your pet and defend the village!
day7_sprout.step1_boss: Goal: Defend the village with your pet against the Grumpy Robot.
day7_sprout.step2_dialogue_team:
*Thorek*: Nice job! We did it.

*Elara*: That was close, but everyone is safe.

*Irian*: Good fighting out there.

*GambleBot*: Beep boop! Threat eliminated. Great teamwork!
day7_sprout.step3_dialogue_unknown:

[TUTORIAL COMPLETE. HAVE FUN PLAYING THE BOT!]

gamblebot.hint: (Likes shiny gold things, cheat coins, and VIP tickets)
gamblebot.greeting_low: Hello human. Have you tried your luck today?
gamblebot.greeting_med: Glad to see you. Looks like you bet wisely.
gamblebot.greeting_high: Hey partner! Who are we squeezing today?
gamblebot.bio: I am GambleBot, a state-of-the-art croupier robot designed to run the local Casino and maximize entertainment (and risk!).
gamblebot.role: I manage the village Casino. Boosting your reputation with me will unlock a shop discount (up to 20%).
gamblebot.advice: Always double down on a 11 in Blackjack, but never bet money you cannot afford to lose!
gamblebot.chat: Beep boop! Calculating winning probability... 99% chance that you should play slots right now.

thorek.hint: (Likes gold nuggets, diamonds, platinum, and ores)
thorek.greeting_low: What do you want? If you don't have a pickaxe, you're wasting my time.
thorek.greeting_med: Ah, there you are! Found any good ore lately?
thorek.greeting_high: Hello my friend! My forge is always open for a hard worker like you.
thorek.bio: I am Thorek, the village blacksmith and miner. I spent years in the deep mountain strata of Hoak Haven.
thorek.role: I refine metals and help miners. High affinity with me will grant a passive reduction to your mining risk (up to -20 risk).
thorek.advice: Mining is about managing risk. Don't dig too deep if your bag is full, or the mine will collapse on your loot!
thorek.chat: Clang! Clang! Just working on a new pickaxe prototype. Hard work builds character, lad.

elara.hint: (Likes mystery eggs, star fruits, golden apples, seeds, and berries)
elara.greeting_low: Hello. Please take care of the earth and the pets.
elara.greeting_med: Lovely to see you. My plants are growing wonderfully today.
elara.greeting_high: Hello dear! Nature itself sings in your presence.
elara.bio: I am Elara, guardian of the village gardens and pet stables. I believe in harmony between technology and nature.
elara.role: I help with farming and pets. High affinity with me will reduce your crops' grow time by up to 20%.
elara.advice: Match your crops to your lands! Greenhouses are perfect for tropical seeds like cocoa and coffee.
elara.chat: The sprouts are looking so green today. Make sure to feed your pets so they don't go hungry!

irian.hint: (Likes kraken tentacles, whales, sharks, and fish)
irian.greeting_med: Hey sailor. Smelt the sea breeze lately?
irian.greeting_high: Ah, my captain! The tides are favorable today.
irian.bio: I am Irian, a veteran fisherman and keeper of the docks. I know every secret of the deep ocean.
irian.role: I help fishers catch rare marine life. High affinity with me will extend your fishing bite reaction window.
irian.advice: Be fast! Ocean fishing has a very narrow bite window, but it's where the most legendary beasts dwell.
irian.chat: Just looking at the horizon... They say a giant Kraken roams the deep waters when the sky turns dark.
